title: TN campaign evidence - per-campaign proof or NOT_TESTED
question: Does each TN row that claims PASS rest on per-campaign evidence, or only on a shared report that would read identically for any row?
definition_of_row_specific: cited artifact contains an entry keyed by the row id AND that entry names a campaign/order/fill identifier

finding_shared_control_report.interpretation: Each TN-CAMP row carries the same 23 checks with identical details; the only per-row difference is the NAME of one check. A check name is not a campaign outcome. No campaign identifier, order id, fill id or manifest appears in the cited report, so the citation would be identical for any TN-CAMP row - the same defect class that demoted 301 rows.

finding_risk_report.interpretation: The risk report does contain a row-keyed check name per row (e.g. TN-F06:LIMIT_BLOCKS_NOT_CLAMPS), but every check detail is empty, no scenario run, order or fill outcome is named, and the artifact covers 14 rows while the matrix row requires a predeclared testnet scenario with exchange parity. A row-keyed NAME is not row-specific evidence.

finding_empty_rows.observation: No evidence_ref, no tested_commit, no notes. Nothing to demote; recorded so the family is accounted for.

finding_missing_sources.observation: The sources named by the TN-CAMP rows point at PHASE_6T_C_* protocol files under local-trading/. The register tree contains 0 local-trading/ files and 0 PHASE_6T files, so the protocol the rows claim to follow is not in the repo either.

can_per_campaign_evidence_be_produced.why: No column in any audit file names a campaign, scenario or manifest, and no run/campaign identifier repeats in the data. The audit records individual send attempts and fills; it cannot be re-cut per campaign without an external mapping that does not exist in the repo. So per-campaign evidence for TN-CAMP-01..09 cannot be produced from this data, and inventing campaign ids would be fabrication.

No campaign manifest exists in the tree and the PHASE_6T_C protocol files named as sources are absent (0 local-trading/, 0 PHASE_6T files). Requires a committed campaign manifest plus exchange order/fill history for the campaign window.
